go_nogo_separation.old_rule: if pilot shows ΔU(D2-D0) > 0 on ≥4/6 tasks with no execution defects
go_nogo_separation.problem: old rule conflates system readiness with benefit signal

new_rules.A_system_ready: all preflight checks pass; executor, evaluator, budget guards, fail-stop verified
new_rules.B_benefit_signal: pilot shows ΔU(D2-D0) direction consistent across ≥3/4 independent events; report effect size and range, NOT significance
new_rules.note: ≥4/6 tasks positive is EXPLORATORY only — 6 tasks from 4 events; proper statistical inference requires ≥10 independent events

preflight.caveat: evaluator in drill mode still uses NODE_TYPE_QUALITY as a proxy for output content — real mode uses actual text vs doc-atom matching
